messages:
Kai Morgan: Heads-up: customer POC with 10k/mo committed credits (9 months) hit a routing dead-end. CPQ sent to BillingOps instead of Deal Desk. Need clearer routing for committed ARR vs one-off discounts.
Lena Ortiz: Oof. Which field routed to BillingOps?
Kai Morgan: Currently `Billing_Exception__c` toggles BillingOps. No field for commit length or annualized commit.
Oscar Wu: Suggest adding `Deal_Approval_Path__c` (enum: standard, deal_desk, billing-review, security-review) computed in CPQ. Logic example: if Commit_Months__c >= 6 OR Annualized_Commit__c >= 60000 THEN 'deal_desk'.
Priya Nair: Add `Rate_Card_Tier__c` so Deal Desk can apply tiered discounts. Values like T1, T2, T3 mapped to ratecard thresholds.
Lena Ortiz: Also surface `BillingImpact__c` text for BillingOps so they know when to route to finance (e.g., unusual payment terms). Don't drop BillingOps from loop.
Kai Morgan: SLA ask: Sales needs a firm promise. Proposed mapping: Approval_SLA__c = '24h' for Tier T1 and no legal; '48h' for T2 or security flag; '72h' for T3 or legal changes. CPQ should set SLA_Expires_At__c timestamp.
Oscar Wu: Include `Deal_Route_Audit__c` with enum reasons: ['commit-length','annualized-commit','discount-tier','billing-term','security','manual']. Useful for queue filters.
Priya Nair: BillingOps note: when `Deal_Approval_Path__c = 'deal_desk'` create BillingOps task only after Deal Desk closes pricing, otherwise BillingOps sees false positives. Tag with `Billing_Pending__c`.
Lena Ortiz: Quick SOQL to validate in sandbox: ```sql
SELECT Id, Name, Commit_Months__c, Annualized_Commit__c, Deal_Approval_Path__c, Rate_Card_Tier__c, Approval_SLA__c FROM Opportunity WHERE Id = 'OPP-7777'
```
Kai Morgan: I'll open ticket DD-1601 for CPQ compute fields + queue mapping. Will patch sandbox tomorrow and post results.
billing-bot: created ticket DD-1601 (owner: @Kai Morgan) https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DD-1601 :white_check_mark:
Oscar Wu: I'll draft the CPQ compute pseudo-code and test vectors. Example pseudo: ```python
if Commit_Months__c >=6 or Annualized_Commit__c >= 60000:
  Deal_Approval_Path__c = 'deal_desk'
  Deal_Route_Audit__c = 'annualized-commit'
  Approval_SLA__c = '48h' if Rate_Card_Tier__c == 'T2' else '72h' if Rate_Card_Tier__c == 'T3' else '24h'
```
Priya Nair: Also recommend adding `Suggested_Template_Id__c` for Legal and a `Billing_Followup_Required__c` checkbox.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks. Action items: Kai -> DD-1601 + sandbox; Oscar -> pseudo-code + test cases; Priya -> template list and BillingOps handoff text. We'll review after sandbox tests. :thumbsup:
